lead: Nahawandi turns cultural voices, melodies and rhythms into driving, groove-heavy techno and electronica with unexpected twists.
paragraphs: Drawing from regional melodic languages and musical systems, his work explores how these traditions can exist naturally within electronic music without being reduced to aesthetic references or stylistic embellishments.

Rather than using these traditions as ornamentation in his tracks, he builds the music around them. Electronic music becomes the framework through which they can exist as rhythmic, danceable experiences without losing their identity. The result is music that connects different musical worlds while remaining rooted in the energy and communal experience of the dancefloor.
Derived from the Arabic maqam Nahawand, the name Nahawandi reflects his commitment to bringing new melodic perspectives to contemporary electronic music.

Through original productions, reworks and live performances, he creates space for musical languages that remain largely absent from today’s electronic music landscape. His live sets are approached as evolving performances rather than fixed sequences, allowing him to reshape arrangements, extend musical ideas and respond to the energy of the room in real time.
